Possibly we need to consider daylight saving time. The question is ambiguous: at what time? Usually we can give the standard difference: Los Angeles is UTC-8 (PST) or UTC-7 (PDT). Berlin is UTC+1 (CET) or UTC+2 (CEST). So difference is 9 hours during standard time, 10 hours during daylight saving time. But we need to check current date: 2026-08-05. In August, both are on daylight saving time: Los Angeles is PDT (UTC-7), Berlin is CEST (UTC+2). So difference is 9 hours. Wait: UTC-7 vs UTC+2 difference is 9 hours. Actually, if Berlin is UTC+2 and Los Angeles is UTC-7, difference is 9 hours. So Berlin is ahead by 9 hours. So answer: 9 hours ahead. Provide explanation. No function call needed.
